newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Balkan countries to harmonise rail cargo tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Balkan countries to harmonise rail cargo tariffs.

text.p: Balkan countries plan to meet this month in Bulgaria to harmonise their railway cargo tariffs in an attempt to make them more competitive, the Bulgarian railway director general said on Wednesday.
"We need a united railway cargo tariff and a Balkan meeting on September 30 in (the Bulgarian town of) Plovdiv is expected to work it out," Anguel Dimitrov told a news conference.
He said the railway general directors of the Balkan countries, due to meet in October in the Greek town of Thessaloniki, were expected to adopt a united tariff for the Balkans.
Bulgaria's state railway has said it will raise cargo charges from October 1 and passenger charges from September 20, both by 20 percent, following a sharp rise in energy prices each month since May.
